author: IGN
description:
We sat down with the development team for Diablo 5 to discuss what to expect when the game launches in 2029. In this video, we chat with Blizzard about how Diablo 5 will affect the ongoing development for Diablo 4, how the itemization is Diablo 5 seeks to return to franchise roots, and how Diablo taking the center stage affects the moment-to-moment of Diablo 5 gameplay.

title: Diablo 5 To Launch With More Classes Than Any Other in the Franchise | Blizzcon 2026

author: IGN
description:
We sat down with the creative director and sesaons lead for Diablo 4 to catch up on all the news that was announced for the game during Blizzcon 2026. Even though Diablo 5 is on the horizon, the developers behind Diablo 4 have assured they have no intentions on slowing down updates for the game. With Diable 4 Season 15: Hell's Legacy right around the corner, and the much requested Amazon Class looming not too far off, Blizzard aims to prove Diablo 4 has a lot of life left to give. 

#ign #gaming
title: Diablo 4 Has No Signs of Slowing Down Despite Diablo 5 - Blizzcon 2026

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Lance Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Lance and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring the slam & charge with the Boost Driver, sending back hits with greater force, and high-velocity pokes. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

#ign #gaming
title: Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance - Official Lance Boosted Action Trailer

author: IGN
description:
After all these years, Blizzard is finally ready to bring us a new StarCraft game... in 2030. But history shows that Blizzard can be a bit lose with their release dates, especially ones that are so far out. However, creative director Dan Hay is very confident that StarCraft will indeed release on time in 2030. Plus, we hear about how the game is shaping and god teases of what we can expect the game might play like. 

#ign #gaming #StarCraft
title: New StarCraft Gameplay Details & a Promised Release Date
